KIAMIS FARMER GUIDE
How to register and redeem the fertiliser e-voucher.
Step 1: Visit your ward agricultural officer with your national ID to be registered on KIAMIS.
Step 2: Confirm your registration by dialling *707# and following the prompts.
Step 3: Wait for the allocation SMS from KIAMIS stating your allocated bags and depot.
WHAT TO BRING TO THE DEPOT
To redeem the e-voucher a farmer must present the national ID card, the allocation SMS, and proof of payment made through eCitizen.
Payment is made on eCitizen before collection. The depot verifies the KIAMIS registration against the ID number.
The e-voucher is valid for 30 days from the allocation SMS.
ELIGIBILITY
All farmers registered on KIAMIS with a valid national ID are eligible for subsidised fertiliser in the current season. Each registered farmer may purchase up to 40 bags per season, subject to land size recorded at registration.
